title: AI Business Quick-Start Checklist: 50 Action Items to Integrate AI This Month
author: Malaclyde
excerpt: A 4-week implementation plan with 50 concrete action items to integrate AI into your business. 30 minutes per day. No fluff, just tasks you can check off.
content:
You know you should be using AI in your business. But where do you start? The options are overwhelming, and every AI expert has a different opinion.

This checklist cuts through the noise. It's a 4-week implementation plan with 50 concrete action items. Each takes 15-30 minutes. No theory, no philosophy — just tasks you can check off.

How It Works

The checklist is structured as four weekly phases, plus a bonus section of quick wins you can implement today.

Week 1: Foundation (10 items)

Set up the tools you need: sign up for AI platforms, identify repetitive tasks, create a workspace, and document your current workflow. By end of week 1, you have the infrastructure ready.

Week 2: Content (10 items)

Generate your first AI-assisted content, create branded templates, set up an email newsletter, and build a content repurposing workflow. By end of week 2, you have a content machine running.

Week 3: Automation (10 items)

Set up Zapier/Make automations, connect tools, automate follow-ups, and create a client onboarding template. By end of week 3, repetitive tasks handle themselves.

Week 4: Optimization (10 items)

Review output quality, optimize prompts, set up A/B testing, create SOPs, and train team members. By end of week 4, AI is fully integrated into your workflow.

Bonus: Quick Wins (10 items)

AI-powered meeting notes, automated invoice reminders, FAQ responses, cross-posting, and a personal AI assistant workflow. These take under 30 minutes each.
